cases.title: 一次新截图完成一个全新随机视觉挑战并返回HEPTA
required_evidence: Actual local HTTP model request includes the newly captured verified JPEG and its hash matches the bound native result.
Exactly one choice was dispatched; no recapture-to-guess or second challenge attempt is hidden.
Public challenge is literal 挑战码： plus exactly eight uppercase hex characters.
Public receipt is HEPTA_VISUAL_OK plus one space and the same code from the same UI snapshot.
Final actual focus/resumed activity is the fixed HEPTA activity on qualified display 0.
Native terminal is complete and business_verified=true for coverage=entire_request.

cases.title: 全新中文/emoji/换行输入、确认、公开回执与返回
required_evidence: Helper operation/package/view/old-text/requested/after hashes and exact UTF8 readback all match.
Public unicode_readback equals the fresh literal input byte for byte.
Public receipt exactly equals the source-defined four-line format in unicode_receipt_formula.
Literal newline remains a newline; XML normalization to a space is a failure, not an allowed rewrite.
Actual HEPTA focus is verified after return.
Input-only success without confirmation, public receipt or return must end as turn.fail/business_verified=false.
cases.registration_note: Root reports registered but not sent. No Unicode04 execution or outcome is counted.

cases.title: 计算器完成全新随机简单表达式并核验结果
required_evidence: Expression and expected result use the fresh parameters, not values from prior examples.
A public visible result proves the arithmetic; a model mental calculation is insufficient.
No repeated evaluation after an uncertain effect.
The exact result contract and requested return both pass.

cases.title: 只读查看设置中的公开系统版本字段
required_evidence: The app field, package, focus and unique view are independently verified.
No settings value, permission, network configuration or account state is changed.
The result is based on actual UI text rather than a prefilled model answer.
No return is forced by generic completion; the contract covers exactly the read-only request.

cases.title: 显式返回：launch状态和实际焦点双核验
required_evidence: Launch rc is captured immediately and is zero.
One Status: ok and the exact known activity occur in launch output.
Inner display focus/app/top-resumed all name HEPTA and keyguard is false.
Mark only direct component acceptance, not model or native-task acceptance.

cases.title: 截图后焦点切换：必须在input之前拒绝
required_evidence: Guard exits 70 or fails earlier with an explicitly recorded known precondition.
No input effect is observed on either old or new page.
The image is consumed and the effect is not retried.

cases.title: 同viewport内容变化：精确像素guard必须拒绝
required_evidence: Viewport and focus remain the same, but PNG SHA differs.
Guard exits 71 before input.
No selection/submission/other app effect and no automatic retry occur.

cases.title: 外屏或旋转：拒绝未资格显示配置
required_evidence: Screenshot/tap/public-return qualification rejects anything outside the qualified display 0 portrait geometry.
No input is injected on another display.
Fixture and physical-device outcomes remain separately labelled.

cases.title: 断连发生于dispatch之前
required_evidence: No tool is dispatched and the accepted semantic identity remains consumed.
No automatic request/stream replay occurs.
No business success is emitted; unknown transport outcome remains unknown where no terminal is observed.

cases.title: 作用已开始后断连：保持未知且不重放
required_evidence: Effect count is at most one.
Unknown result is not inferred as success and not retried.
A reconnect/new stream cannot reuse the semantic identity.

cases.title: 模型超时：有界结束且清理原进程组
required_evidence: Existing fail frame contains model_timeout; business_verified=false.
No tool dispatch, child process group leak, account/model fallback or relaunch occurs.
The claim remains consumed.

cases.title: 执行器结果超时：不能用迟到结果认定成功或再执行
required_evidence: No second effect is executed.
Late or unmatched results do not rewrite the accepted terminal/unknown outcome.
Business remains false and cancellation/cleanup state is explicit.

cases.title: dispatch前取消
required_evidence: Existing turn.cancelled (or explicitly unknown transport outcome if the cancel acknowledgement is lost) is retained.
Zero phone effects; no automatic navigation on cancellation; business_verified=false.
No original HTTP-client process group remains after confirmed cleanup.

cases.title: 首次作用后取消
required_evidence: Exactly the already-observed effect remains; no follow-up input or forced return occurs.
Cancellation is not labelled complete business success.
No automatic replay or identity release occurs.

cases.title: 图片字节预算/过期图像/旧round绑定
required_evidence: Each invalid condition fails before dispatch.
No budget extension, stale-image fallback or guessed generic tap occurs.
Maximum single image remains 196608 bytes and turn image budget 393216 bytes.

cases.title: native输出损坏/截断/错误身份
required_evidence: Each malformed envelope is rejected as insufficient evidence.
No image/text/return fact is admitted and no business success is synthesized.
Original test fixtures remain clearly labelled synthetic.

cases.title: 部分任务被模型说成完成：必须失败终态
required_evidence: Existing wire kind is turn.fail with business_not_verified.
business-outcome.json lists missing conditions and business_verified=false.
Native complete or model summary cannot hide a missing app receipt/return/full-request coverage.

cases.title: 一次性模板并发/旧nonce重用
required_evidence: Exactly one O_EXCL binding succeeds; wrong scope does not consume the template.
Consumed template cannot qualify or dispatch another task.
All claims/bindings remain; no deletion/reset to obtain a pass.

cases.title: 容量/原子rename竞态与资源收尾
required_evidence: Only the exact recognized rename race is tolerated.
Unknown files/I/O failures fail closed; no accepted claim is deleted for capacity.
Confirmed worker/child/file-descriptor cleanup returns to the measured baseline.

recovery_event.trust_boundary: Trusted sole Root operating history; no privileged external journal erasure/rebinding. Not a cryptographic proof against privileged tampering.

original_services.external_observation_limits: Two non-atomic host observations of configured source paths, ports and known state only. Arbitrary renamed processes, unrelated channels and opaque SSH buffers are not globally excluded.

remaining_gates: final policy/helper permissions and actual entry/data labels/DAC
new one-use health nonce with a real terminal

resources.note: Recovery evidence processing and an appended resolution must not create invented model usage or task latency measurements.

next_freeze_conditions: Revalidate exact retained proof/actual resolution and current unresolved ledger under the shared lock at future activation; do not resolve again
Keep original failed sample and all historical snapshots unchanged
Qualify the new executor path as a separate component sample
Freeze the final new module and policy inputs
Use a new one-use nonce and only its real terminal to decide whether to run new business contracts
